title: Emerald Utilities
body:
![Emerald items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ee876cedca10f9c777480a61e9995b8f2003891.png)
Adds Utility of Emerald, you can make Tools and Armors which are almost as strong as diamond items, offering new crafting options, improved durability, and a fresh reason to mine emeralds in your world.
